customManagers.description: Annotated pins in the cluster dirs: Flux postBuild *_VERSION substitutes, OCIRepository ref.tag, Kustomization images[].newTag and `version:` (FluxInstance distribution, HelmRelease chart.spec.version; #843), and container image: <dep>:<version> lines, each followed by `# datasource=<ds> depName=<dep>` on the same line. Same convention as stuttgart-things/stuttgart-things. Nothing may stand between value and annotation -- an unmatched pin is not an error, it is silence. Helm charts add `registryUrl=<repo>`.
Crossplane Configuration/Provider/Function packages, `package: <oci-ref>:<tag>`, synced by Argo CD from main onto crossplane-mgmt (#843). The OCI ref IS the depName, so no annotation is needed.

workstation/tools.yaml: the jump host's CLI pins (`<tool>_version: <v> # datasource=<ds> depName=<dep>`, the sthings.container.tools convention of stuttgart-things/ansible). The cluster manager above only reads clusters/ and upper-case *_VERSION keys, so these sat unmanaged (#843 comparison). kubectl is tracked via kubernetes/kubernetes releases: kubernetes/kubectl only carries v0.x staging tags, so a v1.x pin there never moves.
Track both edge Flux repo pins without modifying generated YAML just to add annotations. ClusterApps lists url before tag; the generated OCIRepository lists ref.tag before url.
Track Edge HOMERUN2_NOTIFICATION_CATCHER_VERSION in its version-only mirror.
Track Edge HOMERUN2_NOTIFICATION_CATCHER_KUSTOMIZE_VERSION in its version-only mirror.
Track Edge MINIO_VERSION in its version-only mirror.

claim-machinery-api profile URLs in CLAIM_MACHINERY_PROFILE_PATH sit at a claim-machinery-api release tag (claim-machinery-api#153); same dep as CLAIM_MACHINERY_API_VERSION, so image and profile move in one PR.

packageRules.description: Keep the edge ClusterApps input and generated OCIRepository pin together in one reviewed promotion.
homerun2-dev's two stuttgart-things/flux GitRepositories (flux-infra, flux-apps) move together, in a PR of their own -- not bundled with other clusters that pin the same repo (harvester#672).

homerun2: one PR per component, so its image and its -kustomize artifact move together instead of two PRs that change adjacent lines and conflict when merged one by one (same rule as stuttgart-things/stuttgart-things and stuttgart-things/flux#208; here #666/#667 and #669/#686 came apart). Edge keeps its own groups (the edge rules below come later and win); sthings-edge is frozen (#683).
Chart 17 needs a separate console image and licensing review; retain the Flux catalogue hold.

platform's two stuttgart-things/flux GitRepositories (flux-infra, flux-apps) move together, in a PR of their own -- not bundled with other clusters that pin the same repo (harvester#672). argocd-catalog (stuttgart-things/argocd) gets its own PR anyway.

machinery-hv's two stuttgart-things/flux GitRepositories (flux-infra, flux-apps) move together, in a PR of their own -- not bundled with other clusters that pin the same repo (harvester#672, #673). Every bump can change the machinery Crossplane profile on a live management cluster: render it first (clusters/machinery-hv/git-repos.yaml).
Freeze bis Aufbau vor Ort, #683; am Aufbautag entfernen. sthings-edge (Edge-TT-Box) pulls main as soon as it has uplink, so no updates under this path until the on-site rollout.
Rancher on platform: an upgrade must fit the Rancher support matrix for this k3s and the Harvester version, so no PR until it is approved in the Dependency Dashboard (#843).
homerun2-dev's Redis is held at 7.2 on purpose: 7.4 writes RDB v12, which 7.2 cannot load (one-way), and there is no backup path yet (harvester#678, #601). Only 7.2 builds (-vN) here (#843).
